problem: The sentence 'doubling the slope halves the spacing' is false if slope means the angle θ, because HE depends on tan θ, not on θ. Doubling θ does not halve HE (at 20° HE is 2.75 times CI; at 40° it is 1.19 times CI).
fix: State it as: doubling the gradient (tan θ, the tangent of the slope angle) halves the spacing, because HE = CI ÷ tan θ.

problem: 'As the valley sides rise upstream' is muddled; it is the valley bed (the line of the stream) that rises upstream, not the sides.
fix: The contour must stay at one RL. The valley bed rises upstream, so the same RL is met farther upstream along the bed than on the valley sides; the line therefore bends upstream and its V points uphill.
